overview:
**Fire danger is Low today, driven by cool temperatures, high fuel moisture, and light winds across the high country.**
- - Fire weather index (BI) sits at 47%, with no watchout thresholds met (0 of 7).
- The week ahead ticks up to Moderate Monday before easing back to Low Tuesday through Saturday as cooling temps push ERC/BI percentiles down into the mid-30s.
- Patchy morning fog and a sunny high near 48°F are expected today, with light south-southwest winds; no Red Flag Warning is in effect.
- Most Western Slope counties lifted fire restrictions as temperatures dropped this fall, and no county or BLM Stage 1/2 restrictions are currently active across the Montrose High Elevation counties—only standard year-round fire rules apply.
- No active wildfires are being reported in or near this area's counties; the only uncontained fire in this week's regional sitrep (Foot Creek, Wyoming) is well outside the zone.
lead: Fire danger is Low today, driven by cool temperatures, high fuel moisture, and light winds across the high country.

sources.name: Most fire restrictions lifted on the Western Slope as temperature drops
